description.value: Creekbread is a wood-fired pizza restaurant in Whistler Creekside that opened just before the 2010 Winter Olympics, situated directly across from the Olympic downhill finish line. The kitchen bakes flatbreads in a wood-burning oven using locally sourced ingredients including Pemberton potatoes and house-made fennel sausage. Its lively après atmosphere and strong community ties make it a natural stopping point for cyclists rolling into Creekside.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Creekbread is an active wood-fired pizza restaurant at Whistler Creekside with online ordering and dine-in service. Takeout is explicitly confirmed by the website ('Takeout will still be running all evening!' and 'Order Online'). The menu lists a 'Tree Hugger (Vegan)' pizza option, confirming vegan availability. No bike-specific amenities, washrooms, water refill, or Wi-Fi are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
